svg.title: PowerContext Gateway · Components, calls, and ownership
svg.desc: An optional gateway is embedded in PowerContext Server, sharing authentication and Scope authorization. The gateway handles protocol ingress, exact context replay, native cache adaptation, and controlled execution. Existing Core owns context organization, domain records, and privacy and efficiency rules. Third parties use the same contracts. Gateway stores replay state; the model service owns KV.
